title: client
summary: Benilla's client body builders: auth_session, char_create, messagechat family, channel family, played_time, random_roll, text_emote, creature/pet-name queries, movement, spline-done, teleport ack, force-speed acks, ping, move-flag acks. MSUI implements auth session (WorldHeaderCrypto proof + BuildAuthSession), char create, messagechat (incl. whisper/channel target), creature query, ping, teleport ack, root/unroot ack, and movement sends.

openItems.text: Entire CMSG_CHANNEL_* / JOIN/LEAVE_CHANNEL builder family: absent
CMSG_TEXT_EMOTE (u32 textId, u32 emoteNum, u64 target): absent - /wave etc. cannot be sent
CMSG_PET_NAME_QUERY (pet number + guid): absent - NPC-summoned pets stay nameless
CMSG_MOVE_SPLINE_DONE: opcode-table-only (Net/Opcodes.cs:269), never built/sent after server-driven splines

CMSG_FORCE_*_SPEED_CHANGE_ACK: only the RUN opcode is in the table (0x00E3) with no handler for SMSG_FORCE_RUN_SPEED_CHANGE and no ack builder - server speed changes are never acknowledged (vmangos will kick/rubber-band)
move-flag acks for water-walk/feather-fall/hover (move_flag_ack with apply dword): absent - only the root/unroot ack exists
